disclaimer: DEMO / SAMPLE RULES ONLY. These rules are illustrative scaffolding for the LM-GUARD MVP. They are NOT the Legal Metrology Act, 2009 or the Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011, and they are NOT a legally verified or complete representation of any regulation. They exist so the deterministic rule engine can be developed and demonstrated. Before any real-world use, replace this file with a ruleset reviewed and signed off by a qualified Legal Metrology authority. Every output of this engine is advisory input to a human inspector; the enforcement decision is always the inspector's.
notes: type=REQUIRED_FIELD   -> the declaration must be present and non-blank.
type=PATTERN_MATCH    -> if present, the value must match `pattern` (Java regex).
type=NUMERIC_RANGE    -> if present, the leading numeric part must sit within [min,max].
type=MIN_LENGTH       -> if present, the value must be at least `minLength` characters.
minConfidence         -> below this the finding is INCONCLUSIVE, never NON_COMPLIANT.
The engine is fully deterministic. No LLM participates in the compliance decision.

rules.description: SAMPLE RULE. A consumer care / customer support contact should be declared on the package.
rules.finding: Required declaration not detected: consumer care contact is absent from the package image.
rules.remediation: Declare a consumer care contact (name, address, phone or e-mail) on the principal display panel.

rules.description: SAMPLE RULE. The maximum retail price must be declared on the package.
rules.finding: Required declaration not detected: maximum retail price (MRP) is absent from the package image.
rules.remediation: Declare the retail sale price, inclusive of all taxes, on the principal display panel.

rules.ruleName: Retail sale price is a well-formed amount
rules.description: SAMPLE RULE. When present, the MRP should read as a currency amount, optionally prefixed by a rupee marker.
rules.finding: Retail sale price is present but not in a readable amount format.
rules.remediation: Print the price as a plain amount, for example: MRP Rs. 99.00 (inclusive of all taxes).

rules.description: SAMPLE RULE. The net quantity must be declared on the package.
rules.finding: Required declaration not detected: net quantity is absent from the package image.
rules.remediation: Declare the net quantity in standard units on the principal display panel.

rules.ruleName: Net quantity uses a standard unit
rules.description: SAMPLE RULE. When present, the net quantity should be a number followed by a standard unit symbol.
rules.finding: Net quantity is present but does not use a recognised standard unit symbol.
rules.remediation: Express the net quantity using standard unit symbols, for example: 500 g, 1 kg, 250 ml.

rules.description: SAMPLE RULE. The name of the manufacturer, packer or importer must be declared.
rules.finding: Required declaration not detected: manufacturer / packer / importer name is absent from the package image.
rules.remediation: Declare the name and complete address of the manufacturer, packer or importer.

rules.ruleName: Manufacturer name is not a stub
rules.description: SAMPLE RULE. A one or two character manufacturer name is almost certainly a misread, not a declaration.
rules.finding: Manufacturer name was detected but is too short to be a valid declaration.
rules.remediation: Confirm the manufacturer name manually against the physical package.

rules.description: SAMPLE RULE. The country of origin should be declared on the package.
rules.finding: Required declaration not detected: country of origin is absent from the package image.
rules.remediation: Declare the country of origin of the commodity.

rules.ruleName: Date of manufacture / packing declaration present
rules.description: SAMPLE RULE. The month and year of manufacture, packing or import should be declared.
rules.finding: Required declaration not detected: date of manufacture / packing is absent from the package image.
rules.remediation: Declare the month and year of manufacture, pre-packing or import.
